title: Expert breakdown of NYC's overpriced commercial vacancies.
summary: Louis Rossmann explains why NYC commercial landlords keep storefronts vacant rather than lowering rents. He points to commercial mortgage-backed security loan terms and inflated property valuations.
why: HN uses it as the go-to explanation of why landlords refuse to renegotiate leases and leave units empty.

quote.text: Louis Rossmann had an excellent breakdown of why the landlords won't budge on the leases
